subject: biology

items.correct: In every living cell (aerobic respiration in mitochondria).
items.why: Cellular respiration releases energy in all cells; breathing is just gas exchange.

items.q: Which releases more energy per glucose?
items.correct: Aerobic respiration — far more than anaerobic.
items.why: Aerobic fully oxidises glucose; anaerobic gives lactic acid (animals) or ethanol+CO₂ (yeast) and far less energy.

items.q: During hard exercise, what causes muscle fatigue?
items.correct: A build-up of lactic acid from anaerobic respiration.
items.misconception: A build-up of oxygen in the muscle.
items.random_wrong: The muscles running out of mitochondria.
items.why: When oxygen is limited, muscles respire anaerobically, producing lactic acid that must later be broken down (oxygen debt).
